A Hurwitz J has strictly left-half-plane spectrum; hence det(Psi(s)I-J) cannot vanish in Re s>=0, including s=0 because det J !=0. The published distributed-order root criterion gives linear/local asymptotic stability. This certifies the fixed baseline against every common nonnegative density supported in (0,1], not compartment-specific memory nor altered model parameters.
